senses.sense_definition: To change from a liquid into a gas or vapor.

examples.text: Heat causes the water to <w>evaporate</w> quickly into the air.

target_lang_translations.tr: Isı, suyun havaya hızla <w>buharlaşmasına</w> neden olur.

target_lang_translations.nl: Hitte zorgt ervoor dat het water snel in de lucht <w>verdampt</w>.
target_lang_translations.pl: Ciepło powoduje, że woda szybko <w>wyparowuje</w> do powietrza.
target_lang_translations.de: Hitze bewirkt, dass das Wasser schnell in die Luft <w>verdunstet</w>.

target_lang_translations.es: El calor hace que el agua se <w>evapore</w> rápidamente en el aire.

examples.text: If you leave the bottle open, the water inside will <w>evaporate</w> completely.

target_lang_translations.tr: Şişeyi açık bırakırsanız, içindeki su tamamen <w>buharlaşacaktır</w>.

target_lang_translations.es: Si dejas la botella abierta, el agua del interior se <w>evaporará</w> por completo.

target_lang_definitions.de: Allmählich verschwinden, sich auflösen oder verloren gehen.
target_lang_definitions.es: Desvanecerse, desaparecer por completo o esfumarse.

senses.sense_definition: To remove water or moisture from something, usually through heat.

examples.text: Factories <w>evaporate</w> milk to produce condensed milk for long storage.

target_lang_translations.pl: Szef kuchni zdecydował się <w>odparować</w> sos, aby stał się gęstszy i bardziej wyrazisty.
target_lang_translations.de: Der Koch beschloss, die Soße <w>einzukochen</w>, damit sie dicker und gehaltvoller wird.
target_lang_translations.fr: Le chef a décidé de faire <w>évaporer</w> la sauce pour la rendre plus épaisse et plus riche.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Isı yoluyla bir şeyin içindeki suyu veya nemi çekmek, buharlaştırmak.

senses.sense_definition: To cause something to fade away, disappear, or be destroyed.

examples.text: The new tax policy could <w>evaporate</w> all the company's annual profits.
